16mm grain, dust, splice marks, edge softness
occasional exposure pumping from manual iris

observer.name: PFC Tanaka
observer.behavior: disciplined, professional, trained to hold framing under stress; panic appears only as mechanical vibration and late tilt errors

narrative_arc.description: Water recedes unnaturally and soldiers stop working.
@Magnitude rises at full kaiju scale from the harbor.
Dorsal plates charge blue, breath fires, film burns out.

cranial posture, threat expression, jaw/eye behavior
cranial appendage, dorsal detail, texture anchors

continuity_rules: @Magnitude must remain the same entity across all visible shots
Maintain heavy textured hide, accurate dorsal plate silhouette, and massive grounded body scale
Do not substitute a generic dragon, dinosaur, lizard, or different kaiju
Dorsal plates are dark/non-glowing in shot 003 and blue-charged only in shot 004
